entities.name: RRC Connection Establishment
entities.description: Procedure for establishing an RRC connection between UE and network.

entities.name: RRCSetupRequest
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: RRCSetup
entities.description: Message sent by network to establish RRC connection.

entities.name: RRCSetupComplete
entities.description: Message sent by UE to complete RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: UE state before RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: UE state after successful RRC connection establishment.

relations.description: RRC connection establishment procedure starts with RRCSetupRequest message
Network responds with RRCSetup message during connection establishment
UE completes procedure by sending RRCSetupComplete message
RRC connection establishment procedure requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state
Successful RRC connection establishment procedure transitions UE to RRC_CONNECTED state
